cors.correction: Configurable: cross-origin access can be enabled for specified origins through the HTTP server's CORS allowed origins setting; it is not categorically unsupported.

notes: HTTP 0 does not establish that the API is dead: the base URL contains the placeholder IP_ADDRESS and represents each user's self-hosted instance. Official docs retain 8123 as the REST example/default, while Home Assistant OS 2026.8 defaults to port 80 and Container remains on 8123. The material defect is the categorical CORS value. No official general REST/WebSocket request quota was located.
